title: MSCI Weighs Indonesia Downgrade, Removal From Global Indexes
summary: Indonesia faces a potential ejection from global stock indexes after MSCI Inc. said the country no longer merits emerging-market status, escalating the threat of foreign investor flight as concerns deepen over market integrity.

title: How Valterra's Forging the Future of Platinum | Chief Financial Officer
summary: Chief Financial Officers now play a critical role in shaping corporate strategy and positioning organizations to meet future challenges. This episode profiles Valterra Platinum CFO Sayurie Naidoo, who leads the world's largest company producing platinum group metals. One year after its demerger from Anglo American, the South African firm is looking ahead to develop new markets for PGMs as the adoption of battery electric vehicles threatens their primary area of demand. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Brazil Judge Orders Meta to Treat Runoff Candidates Equally
summary: A Brazilian electoral court judge ordered Meta Platforms Inc. not to interfere with the distribution of political or election-related content from any candidate in the Oct. 25 runoff.

title: Gold Holds Gains With Haven Demand and Lower Yields in Focus
summary: Gold steadied after rising the most in more than two weeks on Thursday as investors sought safety from a stocks selloff in bonds, pushing down Treasury yields.

title: China’s Plan to Make Yuan a Global Currency Enters Faster Phase
summary: China’s campaign to promote the global use of the yuan appears to be accelerating as the authorities seek to build a more comprehensive financial ecosystem for the currency beyond just trade settlement.

title: Hong Kong’s APEC Comeback Showcases a City Remade by Beijing
summary: Hong Kong lost the chance to host a key gathering of global finance ministers 12 years ago as pro-democracy protests loomed. Now, Beijing is giving it another chance in a city where its tightening grip has made such dissent all but unthinkable.

title: Harvard Fund Hits Record $68 Billion After 27% Annual Return
summary: Harvard University’s endowment jumped to a record $68 billion as successful bets on equities and venture capital including SpaceX holdings helped the richest US college weather an unprecedented pressure campaign from President Donald Trump.

title: Texas Senate Race Will Come Down to Turnout, Says Siena's Levy
summary: Don Levy, director of the Siena Research Institute, said that while the Democratic party itself is not gaining in popularity, 'change' is what's on top of mind for voters, and 'they want their lives to be better' and see voting as a way to do that. Levy also discussed the fight for Latino voters in Texas and other sunbelt states and said that many voters believe that ICE tactics go too far.  (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Indexing Sports: How Team Stats Become Tradeable Assets
summary: In this episode, we explore the financial infrastructure behind the new crop of sports ETF filings and indexes that measure the performance of individual teams.

title: The Investment Lessons Learned from 1873
summary: Long before the Great Depression or the 2008 financial crisis, the world endured its first truly global financial crash. In his new book, 1873: The Rothschilds, the First Great Depression, and the Making of the Modern World, Pulitzer Prize–winning author Liaquat Ahamed traces how a booming global bond market, railroad speculation and massive flows of capital helped fuel extraordinary growth before the bubble burst. At the center of the story were the Rothschilds, the powerful banking dynasty that helped transform government borrowing and global finance. Ahamed joins Bloomberg Businessweek Daily to discuss why 1873 still matters, how railroad mania compares with today’s rush into AI infrastructure, and what the era can teach investors about bubbles, monetary-policy mistakes and financial resilience. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Hot US Inflation, Treasury Safe Haven, CoreWeave's Credit Risk

(Source: Bloomberg)

title: Porsche CEO With a First Look at Mission S Sports Car
summary: At a world premiere in Queens, Porsche CEO Michael Leiters told Bloomberg’s Matt Miller that the company’s new sports car will launch a distinct model line positioned well above the 911. The mid-engine platform is designed to support several variants and is flexible enough for either hybrid or combustion-only powertrains. The two speak on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Ross Gerber on Tesla Roadster, Potential SpaceX Merger
summary: Ross Gerber discussed Tesla’s anticipated Roadster unveiling, following a Barclays note suggesting Tesla and SpaceX could merge before year-end, potentially ahead of Tesla’s annual general meeting. Gerber said a high-priced car made in low volumes would not materially affect Tesla financially. He speaks with Romaine Bostick on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Gold Rallies as Lower Yields, AI Stock Selloff Fuel Haven Demand
summary: Gold increased as an equity selloff drove investors into bonds, pushing Treasury yields lower.

title: IEA Agrees to Release of Outstanding 100 Million Oil Barrels
summary: The International Energy Agency said that member countries agreed to complete the release of 100 million barrels of oil that are still outstanding from an intervention in March aimed at cooling high fuel prices.

title: Porsche CEO Leiters on New Luxury Supercar, China and EVs
summary: Porsche AG unveiled a concept previewing a new supercar, the Mission S, that will be positioned above the 911 in its lineup. Speaking with Matt Miller on "Bloomberg The Close," Porsche CEO Michael Leiters discusses the new supercar and also comments on the state of the China market, the future of electric vehicles and the German automaker's storied legacy. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Big Take: What Is the US Economy Trying to Tell Us?
summary: On today’s Big Take podcast, editors Matt Boesler and Cristina Lindblad join Sarah Holder to unpack what the data says is happening in the US economy and why consumer sentiment tells another story.  (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Rate Volatility Might Shake Fundamentals: Tannuzzo
summary: Gene Tannuzzo, global head of fixed income at Columbia Threadneedle Investments, and Subadra Rajappa, head of research at Société Générale Americas, join Scarlet Fu on "Bloomberg Real Yield." Treasuries led a global bond rally as a selloff in artificial-intelligence shares deepened, spurring demand for havens from a growth slowdown. (Source: Bloomberg)
